messages:
Ava (CEO): Morning — quick stewardship brief for the week. TL;DR: Private GA runway looks good, small incident last night (resolved), two policy updates (retention + on-call rotation), and one ask: please prioritize latency wins in the next sprint. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Miguel (VP Eng): Thanks — quick note: Private GA deploy is in final validation. Perf numbers from staging are within 8% of target for 99th pct latency. Still tuning batching knobs. :wrench:
Rae (VP Product): Shipping checklist for GA attached to the console doc. Main outstanding: billing edge cases for multi-tenant routing. Working with Sales on communication plan. :memo:
Sam (Head of SRE): Incident summary from last night: brief K8s autoscaler mis-schedule during a zone flapping event. Impact: 4 min elevated 5xx on dedicated pools in us-west-2, automatic fallback to hosted completed as designed. Root cause: noisy node provider health-checks + a scaling policy edge. Mitigation deployed: tightened probe thresholds and added a second fallback rule. Full postmortem in #postmortems by EOD. :white_check_mark:
Ava (CEO): Thanks Sam. Key ask: ensure the fallback dashboards have an explicit playbook section — we should be able to run a one-click rollback from console. Miguel, can you own a short RFC?
Miguel (VP Eng): Got it. I'll put up an RFC today for a rollback button + telemetry guardrails. ETA Tues EOD.
Dana (People Ops): Quick policy updates to announce: 1) On-call rotation window will move from 9am-6pm to 8am-5pm PST to improve overlap with APAC partners. 2) Data retention policy tweak: logs for hosted API will be retained 30d by default (was 14d) for better tracerability for customers. Both require manager acknowledgement in 72h. Link in the handbook.
Rae (VP Product): Note on comms: we'll send a customer note about GA timeline + retention change. No pricing change. Keep legal looped.
Ava (CEO): Metrics snapshot: weekly MRR growth +2.1%, host API RPS +6% w/w, 99p latency for chat endpoints trending down 3% after batching tweaks. Cost per 1k tokens dropped ~1.8% (good). Continue focusing on latency/cost pairs.
Miguel (VP Eng): Two engineering asks for teams: 1) prioritize 99p latency improvement for chat (target -10% in 4 wks). 2) Finish backlog of small quantization PRs that materially cut memory in dedupe workloads.
Sam (Head of SRE): Ops ask: please sign up for the new incident rotation spreadsheet if you haven't. We need two more rotations covered for May.
Ava (CEO): Hiring update: we are lifting the last of the hiring pause for roles under product and infra up to IC4. Please route exceptions through your VP.
Rae (VP Product): Launch cadence: Private GA soft opens next Thu for a small cohort (partners). Full market GA targeted two weeks after if no major regressions. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline: private-ga/v1.0 -> green. Canary: 20% across us-west and eu-west. No failed jobs.
Miguel (VP Eng): Small note — toggle for KV cache TTL is currently not exposed in console for Dedicated customers; adding a control panel item in the GA checklist.
Ava (CEO): Two behavioral asks to close the week: 1) When you file a postmortem, include the one-paragraph customer impact summary at top. 2) When you request a policy change, include the rollback criteria. Makes exec reviews much faster.
Dana (People Ops): Reminder — all-hands Friday 9:30am PT, founders will run a short AMA focused on GA and incident learnings.
Ava (CEO): Thanks team. Anything blocking your top priorities?
Rae (VP Product): Nothing blocking from Product.
Miguel (VP Eng): On track, RF C + rollout work today.
Sam (Head of SRE): Need a quick review from Security on the tightened probe thresholds — dropping a PR in 30m.
Ava (CEO): Cool. If no other blockers, that's it — short update this week. Appreciate the quick turnaround on the incident postmortem. :pray:
Miguel (VP Eng): Noted.
Dana (People Ops): Acknowledge — will publish policy ack reminders.
Ava (CEO): Closing note: small wins compound — focus on the latency/cost tradeoffs and reliability playbooks. Have a good week everyone. :sun_with_face:
